d: Choir of Women and Men. Magnificent gallery that puts at the harem of the Sultan: facing wide staircase leading to long practicable loggias, adorned with vases of flowers and perfumes. Other steps on the sides communicate with the loggias and the upper apartments.
Corasmino with follow-up of Muslim officers.
Zaira and Fatima.
The music starts again from the harem: the Schiavi, the Odalisches, the Eunuchs reappear.
Orosman and sayings.
Meledor and sayings.
Nerestano with Séguito and sayings.
Underground atrium that puts in the prisons where the French slaves are locked up. Castiglione and Nerestano.
Choir of French Prisons.
Zaira and sayings, then Lusignano supported by two slaves.
Meledor and Soldiers.
Interior of the harem. Orosmane, Corasmino and Guards.
Meledor and sayings.
Meledor, Nerestano, Indi Zaira.
Orosmane, Corasmino, Officers and Slaves, all the Sultan's courtship.
Zaira's rooms, Fatima and Zaira.
Orosmane, Zaira, and Fatima who, at a nod of Orosmane, withdraws.
A remote place near the district assigned to the French Knights. The freed Knights come out very afflicted: they mourn the death of Lusignano.
Castiglione, Nerestano and sayings.
Meledor with Guards, and sayings.
Nerestano, Castiglione and Knights.
Earthly hall in the harem: in front of large arches with glazed from which you can see the slopes of the mountain. Orosmane, Meledor and Guards.
Orosmane, ind Corasmino.
At the beginning of Orosmane, Zaira goes out and goes on to him. It hints at her eagerly to remain. Corasmino draws him with him. Zaira remains immobile and surprise.
Fatima, Zaira.
The keys and the guards are flowing around.
A remote part in the Gardens of the Harem. Far away, and through the plants, rise the minarets of a mosque. Orosmane, in the south of Corasmino.
Zaira accompanied by Fatima, then Nerestano and sayings.
At the cry of Zaira, Nerestano and Fatima the Slaves and Guards come out from various parts with faces.
